scope.summary: Deliver the first operator-usable Ferric Forager production slice: the shipped fforager entrypoint accepts one representative direct HTTP/HTTPS media input, resolves and selects it through the production engine, acquires bytes through the approved production transport, commits a validated durable output and archive result, emits structured diagnostics, and runs with an independent failure-isolated watcher.
in_scope: Create only the accepted Section 9 product packages and private modules required by this direct-HTTP vertical slice; no skeleton-only package may close the packet.

Expose the shipped fforager command through the launcher/CLI composition path; the launcher owns a separately terminable worker and independent watcher as siblings, and the worker executes the one engine path rather than duplicating behavior in frontends.
Accept one committed deterministic direct HTTP/HTTPS media fixture through a supervised local protocol-server boundary and produce a validated operator-visible output.
Resolve the input into the canonical serializable source graph, apply deterministic representation selection, and preserve stable job, source, asset, output, archive, and diagnostic identities.

Use the approved FF-DEC-002 ordinary transport boundary with Ferric-owned address admission, redirect, cookie, proxy, retry, timeout, cancellation, backpressure, and receipt policy; fingerprint-required cases remain typed unsupported and never fall back to wreq.

Start the minimum independent watcher as a sibling process through governed startup, prove bounded Ready/degraded behavior, preserve crash evidence, and prove watcher absence, crash, incompatibility, hang, or storage failure cannot change Ferric correctness or the decided result.

Build the locked release profile once, record the artifact digest, stage that exact product artifact outside source/build/governance roots, and execute success, negative, cancellation, recovery, watcher-degraded, and required-observable counterfactual scenarios through the shipped entrypoint.
